goal: Further reduce fan-out by extracting constructor-resolution and the deprecated class-to-resolved-type utility (methods that depend on ConstructorResolutionLogic and SymbolSolver.classToResolvedType) into a new helper class, removing those external dependencies from JavaParserFacade.

ops.details: Create new class ConstructorAndLegacyFacade in the same package. Move the two constructor-resolution methods and the deprecated classToResolvedType method into it. The new class will be constructed with a TypeSolver (and may use JavaParserFacade.get(typeSolver) as needed) so behavior is preserved. Update JavaParserFacade to delegate these operations to an instance of ConstructorAndLegacyFacade. This extraction removes direct dependence on ConstructorResolutionLogic and on SymbolSolver.classToResolvedType from JavaParserFacade, because those calls appear only in the moved methods.
Add imports required by the new class (e.g. ConstructorResolutionLogic and SymbolSolver) and remove those imports from JavaParserFacade where they are no longer required.

inputs: internal references and any external callers
ops.details: Replace the body of the moved methods in JavaParserFacade with delegation to the new ConstructorAndLegacyFacade instance so the public API is preserved.
